title: Standard Form: Huge and Tiny Numbers
summary: Writing numbers as a × 10ⁿ, from atoms to galaxies, and calculating with them.

ib.note: Scientific notation is MYP 3 Number (used across MYP Sciences)

cbse.chapter: Earlier NCERT Ch 10: Exponents and Powers

objectives: I can write very large and very small numbers in standard form.
I can convert standard form back to ordinary numbers.
I can compare and calculate with numbers in standard form.
misconceptions: A bigger exponent always means a bigger number, even with negative exponents.
